scopes.name: allocation-create-1
scopes.description: Measured real CreateProject allocation setup for one deposit; the prior public fixture used the same count but used a non-standard PUBLIC label and no clock/state contract.

scopes.name: allocation-deposit-1
scopes.description: One real GNS DepositGns call with principal transfer and getter clone-isolation assertion outside the measured window.

scopes.name: reward-1
scopes.description: One real reward collection after the claimable boundary, asserting returned reward equals the OBL balance increase.

scopes.name: repeat-1
scopes.description: Immediate repeated public reward collection with zero reward and unchanged balance.

scopes.name: refund-before-withdraw-1
scopes.description: Real project refund at the 180-day project end before any deposit withdrawal, asserting recipient balance delta.

scopes.name: withdraw-1
scopes.description: Every real CollectDepositGns call for the one-deposit lifecycle, asserting return signature, GNS principal, and reward balance monotonicity.

scopes.name: refund-final-1
scopes.description: Conditional final public refund call when post-withdrawal rounding dust remains; zero-dust runs record a deterministic State line rather than a synthetic no-op.

scopes.name: allocation-create-100
scopes.description: Measured real CreateProject allocation setup for the 100-deposit workload.

scopes.name: allocation-deposit-100
scopes.description: 100 real staggered heterogeneous GNS deposits (1m/2m/3m repeating), replacing the prior non-standard PUBLIC fixture while retaining its count and per-call measurement.

scopes.name: reward-100
scopes.description: Every real reward collection for 100 deposits after the claimable boundary, asserting returned rewards and OBL transfers.

scopes.name: repeat-100
scopes.description: Immediate same-time repeat against the first of 100 deposits; expected zero reward and no balance change.

scopes.name: refund-before-withdraw-100
scopes.description: Real project refund at the 180-day project end before withdrawals, asserting the recipient's actual OBL delta.

scopes.name: withdraw-100
scopes.description: Every one of the 100 real CollectDepositGns calls, asserting each returned principal, GNS balance delta, and reward balance monotonicity.

scopes.name: refund-final-100
scopes.description: Conditional final public refund transfer for post-withdrawal rounding dust; the prior 100-deposit run observed this path, while zero-dust runs remain explicit in State output.

scopes.name: complete-lifecycle-1
scopes.description: All measured lifecycle calls for this deposit count; setup funding/approvals excluded, individual actor effects retained in phase scopes.

scopes.name: complete-lifecycle-100
scopes.description: All measured lifecycle calls for this deposit count; setup funding/approvals excluded, individual actor effects retained in phase scopes.

workload_difference: The old launch/public-fixtures workload was run by a bespoke launch/run.py with PUBLIC labels and counts 1/10/100 plus a separate rate fixture. These standard tracker fixtures intentionally retain only counts 1 and 100, retain staggered 1m/2m/3m deposits and real lifecycle calls, measure every deposit/reward/withdraw call, add same-time repeat and clock/state assertions outside metric windows, and omit the old synthetic rate probe.
